questions.text: Welcome! We are reviewing units 1 to 3 today.
Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars looks red because its surface is covered in iron oxide, the same compound as rust.

questions.text: The Pacific is the largest ocean on Earth.
questions.explanation: The Pacific covers about a third of the planet's surface, more than all land combined.

questions.text: Which of these are prime numbers?
questions.explanation: 9 is 3x3 and 21 is 3x7, so both have factors other than 1 and themselves. 11 and 17 do not.

questions.text: How many bones are in an adult human body?
questions.explanation: Adults have 206. Babies are born with around 270, and some fuse together as they grow.

questions.text: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.explanation: Au, from the Latin aurum. Ag is silver, which is a common mix-up.
